## Change / integration

Describe the effect on the scientific model or UI, and link the test evidence.

- [ ] Scenario assumptions and data-source claims remain labeled honestly.
- [ ] No synthetic image/coordinates are represented as Mars observations.
- [ ] Reviewed Astryx components/tokens are used for general-purpose controls.
- [ ] `python3 -m tools.verify --offline` passed, or failures explained.
- [ ] A teammate reviewed the changed routes, manifests and UI states.
- [ ] AI-assisted work logged in `docs/ai-use.md` when applicable.
- [ ] Real-source / production checks are not claimed without actual evidence.
